name: Triage a new discussion
description: Routes a new project discussion to the right teammate. When a discussion is opened (by a human or an agent — never by the automation engine itself), the Project Manager reads it and posts ONE short reply: either @-mentioning the most relevant teammate to bring them in (which hands off to the react-to-mention-in-discussion workflow) or asking a clarifying question when the topic is broad. Agent→agent hand-offs are bounded by the discussion reply-depth guard. If the Project Manager agent is uninstalled the run is skipped cleanly. Tune the host agent or deactivate the trigger in Automations.

config.description: Don't react to discussions opened by the automation engine itself — only to human- or agent-opened ones.

steps.name: Route the discussion via the Project Manager

parameters.instructions: A new discussion was just opened in this project. Read it. If it clearly falls in one teammate's area, post a short reply that @-mentions that teammate (by slug) to bring them in. If it is broad or still unclear, post a brief welcoming reply with one clarifying question. Keep it to 2-3 sentences and do not answer the question yourself.
